findings.description: The `_patch_sources` helper monkey-patches `news_bot.SOURCES` to a 2-element list of locally-built callables. It doesn't verify that the real module actually has exactly two fetchers — if Task 10 or later adds a third source, some tests may silently miss coverage of it. Mitigated by: the test suite's `test_sources_registry.py` has a 'exactly two entries' assertion, which is the proper home for that invariant.
findings.recommendation: No action. Test scope is correctly bounded.

findings.description: Uses `importlib.reload(news_bot)` to re-evaluate the module-level constants. `pending_articles_repo` holds a reference to the (old) `news_bot` module — after the first reload, the repo still points at the old module object. For this test the impact is nil (we don't exercise the repo under reload), but a future reader may be surprised. Cleanup in `finally` reloads once more to restore, so the rest of the suite sees a fresh `news_bot` — confirmed by running the full suite after this file (276 green).
findings.recommendation: No action. Documented here so a future teammate reading reloads knows the boundary.

findings.description: The old `test_telegraph_failure_skips_teaser_and_db` case was removed rather than flipped — in prep-phase there's no telegraph call to fail, so the behaviour it asserted has moved into Task 8's `hw_review publish`. This is noted in the decisions.md deviation block.
findings.recommendation: No action. The behaviour is now Task 8's and will be covered by test_hw_review_publish_flow.py.

findings.description: Good behavioural assertion: both `count_pending() == 1` AND `fetch_full_article.call_count == 1` are checked — this catches both over-staging AND over-fetching regressions.

The old `test_init_db_creates_table` assertion-shape was updated correctly (execute-in-list rather than execute-last). The new `test_init_db_also_creates_pending_tables` checks each of the three new tables is DDL'd; together they pin both the processed_news DDL (against accidental deletion) and the delegation.
